stem.en: Why does oxidising strength fall going down the halogen group from fluorine to iodine?
stem.et: Miks langeb oksüdeeriv tugevus halogeenide rühmas alla liikudes fluorilt joodile?

label.en: The outer shell is further from the nucleus, so the incoming electron is less strongly attracted
label.et: Väliskiht on tuumast kaugemal, seega tõmmatakse sisenevat elektroni nõrgemalt ligi

label.en: Heavier halogens have fewer outer electrons available to gain
label.et: Raskematel halogeenidel on omandamiseks vähem väliselektrone saadaval

label.en: All halogens have identical oxidising strength, since they are in one group
label.et: Kõigil halogeenidel on identne oksüdeeriv tugevus, sest need on ühes rühmas

label.en: Oxidising strength depends only on physical state, not on atomic structure
label.et: Oksüdeeriv tugevus sõltub ainult agregaatolekust, mitte aatomiehitusest
